run_demo_viser: run the VGGT demo to visualize 3D points and camera poses from images using viser
create_viser_server: create a viser server that visualizes predicted 3D points and camera poses with interactive GUI controls
apply_sky_segmentation: apply sky segmentation to filter out sky regions from 3D point cloud confidence scores
visualize_camera_frames: visualize camera frames and frustums in the 3D scene with clickable viewpoint navigation
update_point_cloud: update the point cloud display interactively based on confidence threshold and frame selector GUI controls
